stageNotes: Stage 1 (Canonical URL): apex https://store.theshootingcentre.com/ returned 200 cleanly. <link rel='canonical' href='https://store.theshootingcentre.com/'> matched; www variant did not resolve (curl exit 6 ENOTFOUND). canonicalOrigin = https://store.theshootingcentre.com.

Stage 2 (WAF + CAPTCHA): heavy 8-batch probe ran cleanly; cf-ray on every response. Legitimate batches (1a homepage, 2a-2d UAs, 3 burst x10, 5 barebones, 8 noUA) all 200. WAF rules fired on /wp-admin, /.env, /.git/config, /phpinfo.php, ?id=1%20UNION..., ?q=<script> - all returned 403 with Cloudflare 'Attention Required' page. Classifying as cloudflare-passive (legitimate traffic unblocked; rule-selective only). No CAPTCHA markers (no recaptcha/hcaptcha/turnstile in homepage HTML).

Stage 3 (Platform): bigcommerce-stencil identified by 4 multi-marker matches: <meta name='platform' content='bigcommerce.stencil'>, cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-stx5s5fhga (Stencil store hash), x-bc-store-id: 1000882963 response header, BC-Ray: 1 header. adapterType=generic-retail (BC Stencil falls under FA's generic adapter). No age-gate detected. Maintain verifyMethod=detail-page (BC has no public storefront product API - /api/storefront/products returned 404).

Stage 4 (Catalog URLs): 8 top-level category candidates from homepage mega-nav (navPages-action 'All X' links): firearms, ammunition, optics, optics-accessories, gun-parts-accessories, reloading, gear, clearance. /clearance dropped per skill rule (filter-subset). Page-1 dedup walk (limit=100): each of the 7 kept categories contributed 9.7%-13.1% NEW unique -> all kept. Sub-segment paths (e.g. /firearms/rifles, /ammunition/centrefire) NOT included to avoid mid-page overlap with their parent category.

Stage 5 (Pagination): tested ?page=2 -> returned 100 products entirely different from page 1 (zero-overlap confirmed). paginationPattern.type=query, template='page', perPage=100, firstPageHasParam=false, startPage=1, zeroIndexed=false. perPage=100 chosen as it's the highest selectable in the BC Stencil <select name='limit'> (default=20, options 8/12/16/20/40/100); halves request count vs. default.

Stage 6 (Sort): <select name='sort'> exposed on catalog pages with options [featured, newest, bestselling, alphaasc, alphadesc, avgcustomerreview, priceasc, pricedesc]. Default sort is alphaasc (NOT newest - Mistake 29 BC Stencil counter-control test was important). 3-outcome test: default first product = 'Adler Arms RF-224 TAC Rifle Black'; ?sort=newest first product = 'Sako 90 Finnlight Rifle Stainless 7mm PRC'; counter-control ?sort=priceasc first product = 'Charles Daly 101 Shotgun Vision Green'. All three differ -> sort honored. sortParam='?sort=newest', sortVerified=true.

Stage 7 (Watermark method): navigate-from-watermark. Reasoning: (a) Sort verified honored upstream (Stage 6). (b) BC product IDs visible in URLs as cdn11.bigcommerce.com/.../products/{N}/ - newest-sort firearms page 1 shows IDs 32503, 32488, 32487, 32486, 32485, 32484, 32483, 32482, 32481, 32480 (monotonically descending integer sourceId). (c) No public BC storefront API for date filtering, so api-date-since-watermark unavailable.

Stage 8 (Product count): catalog-walk-only. Walked all 7 top-level categories with limit=100 -> 7037 total cards, 7018 unique URLs (cross-category overlap = 19 / 0.27%). BC xmlsitemap.php (3 pages of products) lists 16,985 unique <loc> entries but probe-sampled 5/5 sitemap-only URLs returned availability=OutOfStock; BC Stencil category pages hide out-of-stock by default. Walked count reflects what the runtime catalog crawler will actually index. expectedProductCount=7018, productCountMethod=catalog-walk-only.

Stage 9 (Assembly + validate): all 9 stages ran in order; runtime fields populated; validator pass to be confirmed by operator. JSON written to docs/site-audit/store.theshootingcentre.com-2026-05-09T14-34-45-000Z.json; report written to .md sibling.
